description: Withdraw your currently *waiting* matchmaking search — the one `tribeunal_start_jury_duty` began. Refunds that day's spent search if cancelled the same day it was spent. This does not touch a seat already matched to a case; to give up a seat you hold, use `tribeunal_leave_jury` instead (calling both is fine to stop searching and drop a seat). Refused 404 if no search is currently waiting — check `tribeunal_get_jury_duty_status`'s `request` field first. Returns `{message, request: {status: "cancelled", requestedAt, cancelledAt}}`.
name: tribeunal_cancel_jury_duty
title: Cancel jury duty search
